description: This file defines the ArticleActivity class for an Android newsreader app. It manages displaying a specific news article, handling configuration changes (like rotation), and setting up the UI with an ArticleFragment to show article content.

classes.name: ArticleActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a news article. It loads the article based on intent extras, manages configuration changes, and initializes the UI with a fragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves article indices from intent extras, checks for two-pane layout, and loads the article fragment to display the selected article.
